Flag Atlas / Predictions & corrections / enable_ufc_for_speed
Gboard developer flag · Predictions & corrections

Ufc For Speed

Uses typing-speed information from Gboard’s User Feature Cache (UFC), which retains learned typing characteristics. This is not a general keyboard speed boost.

enable_ufc_for_speed
Find in full AtlasSuggest correction ↗

Interpretation and limitations

This flag is classified under Predictions & corrections with Optional priority and an estimated impact of Usually low.

Evidence level: Interpreted. This interpretation is based on the identifier and surrounding context; exact effects are not independently confirmed.

Research note: Read-only examination of GboardWu 18.5.4 APK found com/google/android/libraries/inputmethod/userfeaturecache/guarder/UfcGuarder, UfcMetricsProcessorModule, UfcUtils, and enable_ufc_for_speed / enable_ufc_for_offset / enable_export_ufc. 'UFC' expansion is supported by the code namespace; exact flag behavior is inferred and not runtime verified.

Research references

  • Google Research — personalized touch offsets and typing speed (background, not flag documentation)
